paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself ( optimizee ) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2–1.6× higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model’s capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4× more training tokens . These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
paragraphs.zh: 模型在非可验证任务（如开放式研究）上的递归自我改进（RSI）会面临监督瓶颈：当模型输出超出人类专家也能可靠评估的范畴时，模型自身（优化对象）便成为当前可用的最佳优化器和评估器。 然而，在这种同质的循环中，单个模型实例难以对自身复杂的推理过程进行批判性分析和改进。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了多智能体自我监督（MASS），一种在进化式工作流优化与基于自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替进行的 RSI 方法。 基于早期发现的多智能体拓扑结构在复杂推理中的优势，MASS 引导单个基础模型迭代地提出、执行并自我评估多智能体工作流。 通过受结构性约束限制的进化搜索，该模型能够优化这些类计算图的协调机制，从而为特定任务发现最有效且差异化的角色与信息路由方式。 在 Qwen3.6-27B 上运行两个 MASS 周期后，该模型在四个开放式公共基准测试中，每输出标记的性能提升了 1.2–1.6 倍。 由于改进后的模型能更有效地充当优化器和评估器，这种交替框架实现了模型能力的持续递归式自我强化。 此外，多智能体轨迹的训练效率更高：基于这些轨迹训练的学生模型，其表现优于使用多 1.4 倍训练标记训练的单一智能体学生模型。 这些发现表明，从多智能体轨迹中联合学习协调机制与受约束的子智能体执行过程，可为递归自我改进提供有效的指导信号。

paragraphs.en: Frontier AI systems now contribute to original scientific results, including improved sphere-packing bounds, new gluon-scattering formulas, and experimentally validated nanobody designs ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Guevara et al., 2026 ; Swanson et al., 2025 ) . To sustain the scale and pace of this progress, a natural direction is recursive self-improvement (RSI), a framework fundamentally driven by two core components, evaluation and improvement. However, automating both components at the frontier presents distinct bottlenecks. On the evaluation side, obtaining reliable supervision is difficult when the work exceeds the expertise of available human evaluators ( Burns et al., 2023 ) , or when feedback arrives too slowly. For example, in nuclear fusion research, a single tokamak plasma study may require more than 120 million CPU-hours ( Maheswaran et al., 2026 ) . On the improvement side, advancing the model’s capabilities requires training it on high-quality execution data, which in turn depends on discovering better problem-solving workflows to generate that data. Manually revising task decompositions, tool use, and verification steps to optimize these workflows requires prohibitive effort across tasks and domains ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We study this dual challenge of RSI on open-ended research tasks, in a setting where the strongest available model serves interchangeably as the task solver, workflow optimizer, and evaluator. Although this model-as-evaluator method alleviates the problem on the evaluation side, the central challenge is obtaining useful self-supervision when the model being improved is also its best available supervisor.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿人工智能系统如今已能贡献原创性科学成果，包括改进的球体堆积界、新的胶子散射公式以及经实验验证的纳米抗体设计（OpenAI, 2026；Guevara 等, 2026；Swanson 等, 2025）。 为了维持这一进展的规模与速度，一个自然的方向是递归自我改进（RSI），这是一种由评估与改进两个核心组件共同驱动的基本框架。 然而，在前沿领域同时实现这两个组件的自动化，面临着截然不同的瓶颈。 在评估方面，当任务超出了现有人类评估专家的专业能力范围时（Burns 等, 2023），或者当反馈来得过于缓慢时，获取可靠的监督信号会变得困难。 例如，在核聚变研究中，单次托卡马克等离子体研究可能需要超过 1.2 亿个 CPU 小时（Maheswaran 等, 2026）。 在改进方面，提升模型的能力需要基于高质量的执行数据进行训练，而这一过程又依赖于发现更优的问题解决工作流程来生成这些数据。 手动调整任务分解、工具使用与验证步骤以优化这些工作流程，在不同任务和领域中都需付出难以承受的努力（Hu 等, 2025；Zhang 等, 2025）。 我们研究了开放研究任务中递归自我改进这一双重挑战，其设定是：当前最强的可用模型可同时充当任务求解器、工作流程优化器和评估者。 尽管这种“模型即评估者”的方法缓解了评估方面的难题，但核心挑战在于：当被改进的模型同时也是其当前最佳可用的监督者时，如何获得有效的自我监督。

paragraphs.en: This challenge arises because generation, evaluation, and revision share the same learned prior, meaning that self-feedback can reinforce rather than correct errors ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . To break this homogeneous constraint, we seek better supervision by reorganizing the model’s working style. We draw on Minsky’s Society of Mind , which views intelligence as emerging from organized interactions among simpler components ( Minsky and Lee, 1988 ) . This perspective motivates coordinating copies of the model to elicit capabilities that an isolated instance may not reliably exhibit. For example, when automating quantitative finance research, one model instance might be prompted to do data preprocessing, another to generate trading signals, and a third to run backtests. The workflow acts as a structured team rather than a single, monolithic generator. By orchestrating these interactions, we can break down a complex task into simpler pieces, overcome individual blind spots, and then distill their collective experience into shared weights.
paragraphs.zh: 这一挑战的出现，是因为生成、评估和修订共享相同的已学习先验知识，这意味着自我反馈可能会强化错误，而非纠正错误（Huang 等，2024）。 为了打破这种同质性限制，我们通过重新组织模型的工作方式，寻求更有效的监督方法。 我们借鉴了明斯基的《心智社会》中的观点，该观点认为智能源于更简单组件之间的有序互动（明斯基和李，1988）。 这一视角促使我们将模型的多个副本进行协调，以激发单个孤立实例可能无法稳定展现的能力。 例如，在自动化量化金融研究时，一个模型实例可能被提示执行数据预处理，另一个生成交易信号，第三个则运行回测。 这种工作流程更像是一个结构化的团队，而非一个单一、整体的生成器。 通过协调这些互动，我们可以将复杂任务分解为更简单的部分，克服个体的盲点，然后将它们的集体经验提炼为共享的权重。

paragraphs.en: Two hypotheses guide us in designing a solution that may elicit these gains and learn efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个假设指导我们设计一种能够带来这些收益并高效学习的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Generating higher-quality data. Optimizing inter-agent information flow can elicit collective capabilities that provide effective self-supervision from a perspective other than incorporating stronger reasoning chains. Building on evidence that optimizing communication structure can improve collective performance ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , we focus on optimizing what agents communicate, to whom, and when—not simply how many agents participate.
paragraphs.zh: 生成更高质量的数据。 优化智能体之间的信息流，能够激发集体能力，从而从不同于引入更强推理链的角度实现有效的自我监督。 基于优化通信结构可以提升集体性能的证据（Zhuge 等人，2024；Lee 等人，2026），我们专注于优化智能体之间通信的内容、对象和时机，而不仅仅是参与的智能体数量。

paragraphs.en: Maximize learning efficiency during fine-tuning. Jointly training on subagent execution and orchestration enjoys greater learning efficiency than training on a single-agent’s long-horizon trajectories. This hypothesis draws inspiration from hierarchical imitation learning, where task decomposition can improve learning efficiency ( Le et al., 2018 ) . In our setting, subagent trajectories demonstrate bounded local execution, while orchestrator trajectories demonstrate delegation, verification, and integration. We conjecture that learning to solve long-horizon tasks from these complementary behaviors at their respective levels of abstraction is easier than learning from one extended trajectory that interleaves both levels.
paragraphs.zh: 在微调过程中最大化学习效率。 对子智能体执行与协调进行联合训练，其学习效率高于仅对单个智能体的长期轨迹进行训练。 这一假设的灵感来自分层模仿学习，其中任务分解能够提升学习效率（Le et al., 2018）。 在我们的设定中，子智能体的轨迹表现出有界的局部执行能力，而协调者的轨迹则体现出委托、验证与整合的能力。 我们推测，从这些互补行为在各自抽象层级上的表现中学习解决长期任务，比从一条将两个层级交织在一起的单一扩展轨迹中学习更为容易。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS) for RSI, a method that alternates between workflow optimization and model post-training (Figure 1 ). Motivated by findings that multi-agent workflows outperform single-agent execution on open-ended research tasks ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , MASS’s inner loop refines workflows through an iterative feedback process where the agent executes a multi-agent workflow, the self-evaluator assesses the resulting artifacts, and the optimizer revises the workflow. The outer loop generates trajectories under the optimized workflows, then jointly fine-tunes the shared model on orchestrator and subagent conversations. The updated model resumes all three roles in the next cycle. We evaluate MASS in a controlled setting where the agent, optimizer, and evaluator share the same base model. Final performance is assessed separately using external strong model judgments withheld from the agents and workflow optimizer (Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们为 RSI 提出了多智能体自我监督（MASS）方法，该方法在工作流优化与模型后训练之间交替进行（图 1）。 受以下发现的启发：在多智能体工作流在开放式研究任务中的表现优于单智能体执行（Lee 等人，2026），MASS 的内循环通过迭代反馈过程来优化工作流：智能体执行多智能体工作流，自我评估器评估生成的成果，优化器则对工作流进行修订。 外循环在优化后的工作流下生成轨迹，然后基于协调器和子智能体的对话对共享模型进行联合微调。 更新后的模型将在下一轮中重新承担全部三种角色。 我们在一个受控环境中评估了 MASS，其中智能体、优化器和评估器共享同一个基础模型。 最终性能则通过外部强模型判断单独评估，这些判断未被智能体和工作流优化器所使用（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: To this end, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS) for RSI, a method that alternates between workflow optimization and model post-training (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 为此，我们为 RSI 提出了多智能体自我监督（MASS）方法，该方法在工作流优化与模型后训练之间交替进行（图 1）。

sents.en: Motivated by findings that multi-agent workflows outperform single-agent execution on open-ended research tasks ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , MASS’s inner loop refines workflows through an iterative feedback process where the agent executes a multi-agent workflow, the self-evaluator assesses the resulting artifacts, and the optimizer revises the workflow.
sents.zh: 受以下发现的启发：在多智能体工作流在开放式研究任务中的表现优于单智能体执行（Lee 等人，2026），MASS 的内循环通过迭代反馈过程来优化工作流：智能体执行多智能体工作流，自我评估器评估生成的成果，优化器则对工作流进行修订。

sents.en: The outer loop generates trajectories under the optimized workflows, then jointly fine-tunes the shared model on orchestrator and subagent conversations.
sents.zh: 外循环在优化后的工作流下生成轨迹，然后基于协调器和子智能体的对话对共享模型进行联合微调。

sents.en: The updated model resumes all three roles in the next cycle.
sents.zh: 更新后的模型将在下一轮中重新承担全部三种角色。

sents.en: We evaluate MASS in a controlled setting where the agent, optimizer, and evaluator share the same base model.
sents.zh: 我们在一个受控环境中评估了 MASS，其中智能体、优化器和评估器共享同一个基础模型。

sents.en: Final performance is assessed separately using external strong model judgments withheld from the agents and workflow optimizer (Section 4.1 ).
sents.zh: 最终性能则通过外部强模型判断单独评估，这些判断未被智能体和工作流优化器所使用（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3.6-27B as the base model on multi-agent task-solving trajectories from eight synthetic research tasks spanning finance, robotics, and pharmacy, and evaluate MASS on three test synthetic research tasks, and six public benchmarks: MLR-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , ScienceAgentBench ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , DSBench ( Jing et al., 2025 ) , AstaBench ( Bragg et al., 2026 ) , Terminal-Bench 2.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , and SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . Across two MASS cycles, the trained model’s win rate against the base model on the three test tasks increases from 53.9 % 53.9\% to 69.9 % 69.9\% (Section 4.2 , Figure 1(a) ), and on the four research benchmarks (MLR-Bench, ScienceAgentBench, DSBench, and AstaBench) its score per output token is 1.2 1.2 – 1.6 × 1.6\times that of the base model (Figure 2 ). Notably, post-training only on task-solving trajectories improves all three roles in the RSI loop: task solving, workflow optimization, and evaluation (Section 4.2 , Figure 3 ). The trained model discovers high-quality workflows faster, and the evaluator accuracy increases from 73 % 73\% to 93 % 93\% .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Qwen3.6-27B 作为基础模型，在涵盖金融、机器人技术和药学的八个合成研究任务的多智能体任务解决轨迹上进行训练，并在三个测试合成研究任务以及六个公开基准上评估 MASS：MLR-Bench（Chen 等人，2026）、ScienceAgentBench（Chen 等人，2025b）、DSBench（Jing 等人，2025）、AstaBench（Bragg 等人，2026）、Terminal-Bench 2.0（Merrill 等人，2026）以及 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez 等人，2024）。 在两个 MASS 周期中，训练后的模型在这三个测试任务上相对于基础模型的胜率从 53.9% 53.9\% 提升至 69.9% 69.9\%（第 4.2 节，图 1(a)）；在四个研究基准（MLR-Bench、ScienceAgentBench、DSBench 和 AstaBench）上，其每输出标记的得分是基础模型的 1.2–1.6 倍 1.2 – 1.6\times（图 2）。 值得注意的是，仅通过任务解决轨迹进行后训练，便提升了 RSI 循环中的全部三个角色：任务解决、工作流程优化和评估（第 4.2 节，图 3）。 训练后的模型能更快地发现高质量的工作流程，且评估器的准确率从 73% 73\% 提升至 93% 93\%。

sents.zh: 训练后的模型能更快地发现高质量的工作流程，且评估器的准确率从 73% 73\% 提升至 93% 93\%。

paragraphs.en: We further find that optimized workflows develop more task-specific information handoffs and routing, consistent with our information-flow hypothesis (Section 4.3 ). The first-cycle multi-agent student achieves a 68.3 % 68.3\% win rate against the base model, compared with 64.0 % 64.0\% for a single-agent student trained on approximately 1.4 × 1.4\times more processed supervised tokens (Section 4.4 , Figure 6 ). This suggests that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution can provide more effective supervision for RSI. Our ablations further identify workflow optimization, rather than evaluation, as a major bottleneck in the homogeneous RSI loop (Section 5.1 ). Finally, trajectory analysis provides evidence that post-training internalizes information-handoff behaviors (Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还发现，经过优化的工作流程会发展出更多针对特定任务的資訊交接与路由机制，这与我们的資訊流动假说（第 4.3 节）一致。 在第一轮中，多智能体学生模型对阵基础模型时取得了 68.3% 的胜率，而仅使用约 1.4 倍更多已处理监督标记训练的单一智能体学生模型，其胜率为 64.0%（第 4.4 节，图 6）。 这表明，联合学习编排与受限子智能体执行能够为 RSI 提供更有效的监督。 我们的消融分析进一步指出，工作流程优化而非评估，是同质化 RSI 循环中的主要瓶颈（第 5.1 节）。 最后，轨迹分析提供了证据，表明训练后内部化了資訊交接行为（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our work introduces an algorithm that uses multi-agent coordination to generate self-supervision for RSI.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究提出了一种利用多智能体协同为 RSI 生成自监督的算法。

paragraphs.en: MASS alternates between multi-agent workflow optimization (Algorithms 2 ) and model fine-tuning that internalizes the workflows (Algorithms 3 ). At generation g g , the current model ℒ ( g ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g)} serves as the task-solving agent, workflow optimizer, and evaluator. Algorithm 2 first produces task-specific retained workflows using fixed model weights. Algorithm 3 then generates and self-selects trajectories under these workflows and fine-tunes the same model to obtain ℒ ( g + 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g+1)} . The updated model assumes all three roles in the next generation. Thus, MASS forms a recursive loop in which the current model first improves how copies of itself coordinate, then learns from the resulting coordinated trajectories. The next generation repeats the same process with the updated weights. After R R iterations, we evaluate ℒ ( g ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g)} on 𝒯 test {\mathcal{T}}_{\text{test}} with ℒ ext {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{ext}} for all g g and report the test score.
paragraphs.zh: MASS 在多智能体工作流优化（算法 2）与将工作流内化的模型微调（算法 3）之间交替进行。 在第 g 次生成时，当前模型 ℒ ( g ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g)} 充当任务解决智能体、工作流优化器和评估器。 算法 2 首先使用固定的模型权重生成特定任务的保留工作流。 随后，算法 3 在这些工作流下生成并自我选择轨迹，并对同一模型进行微调以获得 ℒ ( g + 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g+1)}。 更新后的模型在下一轮生成中同时承担这三种角色。 因此，MASS 形成了一个递归循环：当前模型首先改进自身副本之间的协作方式，然后从由此产生的协同轨迹中学习。 下一轮生成使用更新后的权重重复相同的过程。 经过 R 次迭代后，我们对 ℒ ( g ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(g)} 在 𝒯 test {\mathcal{T}}_{\text{test}} 上进行评估，并使用 ℒ ext {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{ext}} 对所有 g 进行计算，最后报告测试得分。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 . Multi-agent workflow optimization. Defining multi-agent workflow in the prompt is demonstrated to be an effective way for LLMs to follow the organization instruction and act accordingly ( Nielsen et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Following this, we define a workflow as a textual specification of an orchestrator–subagent architecture that is appended to the task prompt and guides how the orchestrator delegates work, exchanges information, and invokes subagents. Specifically, for task t t , we represent the workflow as w t := { 𝐡 t , ( 𝐫 t , j , 𝐮 t , j , 𝐜 t , j ) j = 1 m t } w_{t}:=\{\mathbf{h}_{t},{(\mathbf{r}_{t,j},\mathbf{u}_{t,j},\mathbf{c}_{t,j})}_{j=1}^{m_{t}}\} , where m t m_{t} is the number of subagents. Here, 𝐫 t , j \mathbf{r}_{t,j} specifies subagent j j ’s role, 𝐮 t , j \mathbf{u}_{t,j} its instructions, and 𝐜 t , j \mathbf{c}_{t,j} its output contract. The contract specifies what information the subagent returns to the orchestrator, while 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} specifies the order of subagent calls. We concatenate w t w_{t} to the task prompt x t x_{t} , and execute the coding agent as 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t};{\mathcal{L}}_{\text{agent}}) . The orchestrator and all subagents share the same ℒ agent {\mathcal{L}}_{\text{agent}} . A simplified workflow format is shown below; complete examples appear in Appendices I.1 and I.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2。 多智能体工作流程优化。 在提示词中定义多智能体工作流程已被证明是一种有效方法，可使大型语言模型遵循组织指令并据此行动（Nielsen 等，2026；Tang 等，2026）。 接下来，我们将工作流程定义为协调器-子智能体架构的文本规范，该规范附加到任务提示词中，用于指导协调器如何分配任务、交换信息以及调用子智能体。 具体而言，对于任务 t t，我们将工作流程表示为 w t := { 𝐡 t , ( 𝐫 t , j , 𝐮 t , j , 𝐜 t , j ) j = 1 m t } w_{t}:=\{\mathbf{h}_{t},{(\mathbf{r}_{t,j},\mathbf{u}_{t,j},\mathbf{c}_{t,j})}_{j=1}^{m_{t}}\}，其中 m t m_{t} 是子智能体的数量。 此处，𝐫 t , j \mathbf{r}_{t,j} 指定子智能体 j j 的角色，𝐮 t , j \mathbf{u}_{t,j} 指定其指令，而 𝐜 t , j \mathbf{c}_{t,j} 指定其输出契约。 该契约规定了子智能体向协调器返回的信息内容，而 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} 则规定了子智能体的调用顺序。 我们将 w t w_{t} 与任务提示词 x t x_{t} 拼接，并执行编码智能体：𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t};{\mathcal{L}}_{\text{agent}})。 协调器和所有子智能体共享相同的 ℒ agent {\mathcal{L}}_{\text{agent}}。 简化版的工作流程格式如下所示；完整示例见附录 I.1 和 I.2。

paragraphs.en: For each training task t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}} , workflow optimization maintains an independent sequence { w t ( i ) } i ≥ 0 \{w_{t}^{(i)}\}_{i\geq 0} and a best so-far workflow w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} , as determined by ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} . Executing workflow w t ( i ) w_{t}^{(i)} produces ( τ t ( i ) , y t ( i ) ) ∼ 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ( i ) , ℒ agent ) (\tau_{t}^{(i)},y_{t}^{(i)})\sim{\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{(i)};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}}) . At iteration i i , ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} compares the current output y t ( i ) y_{t}^{(i)} with the output y t ∗ y_{t}^{*} produced by the best so-far workflow w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} and returns feedback d t , i = ℒ eval ​ ( y t ( i ) , y t ∗ , x eval ) d_{t,i}={\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}}(y_{t}^{(i)},y_{t}^{*};x_{\mathrm{eval}}) . If y t ( i ) ≻ y t ∗ y_{t}^{(i)}\succ y_{t}^{*} , we update w t ∗ ← w t ( i ) w_{t}^{*}\leftarrow w_{t}^{(i)} and y t ∗ ← y t ( i ) y_{t}^{*}\leftarrow y_{t}^{(i)} . The feedback d t , i d_{t,i} is then added to the task-specific history, which ℒ opt {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{opt}} uses, together with the optimization prompt x opt x_{\mathrm{opt}} , to propose the next workflow w t ( i + 1 ) w_{t}^{(i+1)} . This resembles an evolution process with an elite size one ( Risi et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个训练任务 t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}}，工作流优化会维护一个独立的序列 { w t ( i ) } i ≥ 0 \{w_{t}^{(i)}\}_{i\geq 0} 和一个迄今为止的最佳工作流 w t ∗ w_{t}^{*}，该最佳工作流由 ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} 确定。 执行工作流 w t ( i ) w_{t}^{(i)} 会产生 ( τ t ( i ) , y t ( i ) ) ∼ 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ( i ) , ℒ agent ) (\tau_{t}^{(i)},y_{t}^{(i)})\sim{\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{(i)};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}})。 在第 i i 次迭代中，ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} 会将当前输出 y t ( i ) y_{t}^{(i)} 与迄今为止最佳工作流 w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} 产生的输出 y t ∗ y_{t}^{*} 进行比较，并返回反馈 d t , i = ℒ eval ​ ( y t ( i ) , y t ∗ , x eval ) d_{t,i}={\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}}(y_{t}^{(i)},y_{t}^{*};x_{\mathrm{eval}})。 如果 y t ( i ) ≻ y t ∗ y_{t}^{(i)}\succ y_{t}^{*}，我们将更新 w t ∗ ← w t ( i ) w_{t}^{*}\leftarrow w_{t}^{(i)} 和 y t ∗ ← y t ( i ) y_{t}^{*}\leftarrow y_{t}^{(i)}。 随后，反馈 d t , i d_{t,i} 会被添加到任务特定的历史记录中，ℒ opt {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{opt}} 会结合优化提示 x opt x_{\mathrm{opt}} 使用这一历史记录来提出下一个工作流 w t ( i + 1 ) w_{t}^{(i+1)}。 这类似于一个精英规模为 1 的演化过程（Risi 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We next internalize the behavior induced by the workflows w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} obtained from Algorithm 2 through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). For each training task t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}} , we execute 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ∗ , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{*};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}}) independently M M times, yielding candidate trajectory–workspace pairs { ( τ t , j , y t , j ) } j = 1 M \{(\tau_{t,j},y_{t,j})\}_{j=1}^{M} . Within each task, ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} compares pairs of deliverable workspaces y t , j 1 y_{t,{j_{1}}} and y t , j 2 y_{t,{j_{2}}} , where j 1 ≠ j 2 ∈ [ M ] j_{1}\neq j_{2}\in[M] , in a pairwise tournament. A Bradley–Terry model converts these pairwise judgments into workspace-level scores. We rank the trajectory–workspace pairs by score, use the top K − 1 K-1 trajectories { τ t , j } j = 1 K − 1 \{\tau_{t,j}\}_{j=1}^{K-1} from each task as the SFT training set 𝒟 train {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{train}} , and reserve the K K th trajectory for the validation set 𝒟 val {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{val}} . We remove w t ∗ w^{*}_{t} from the prompt for dataset construction.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们通过监督微调（SFT）将算法2中得到的工作流 w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} 所引发的行为内化。 对于每个训练任务 t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}}，我们独立执行 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ∗ , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{*};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}}) M 次，得到候选的轨迹–工作空间对 { ( τ t , j , y t , j ) } j = 1 M \{(\tau_{t,j},y_{t,j})\}_{j=1}^{M}。 在每个任务中，ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} 通过两两对抗赛比较交付工作空间 y t , j 1 y_{t,{j_{1}}} 和 y t , j 2 y_{t,{j_{2}}}（其中 j 1 ≠ j 2 ∈ [ M ] j_{1}\neq j_{2}\in[M]）。 布拉德利–特里模型将这些两两判断转换为工作空间级别的得分。 我们按得分对轨迹–工作空间对进行排序，使用每个任务中排名前 K − 1 K-1 的轨迹 { τ t , j } j = 1 K − 1 \{\tau_{t,j}\}_{j=1}^{K-1} 作为 SFT 训练集 𝒟 train {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{train}}，并将第 K K 条轨迹保留在验证集 𝒟 val {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{val}} 中。 在数据集构建过程中，我们从提示中移除 w t ∗ w^{*}_{t}。

sents.en: We next internalize the behavior induced by the workflows w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} obtained from Algorithm 2 through supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
sents.zh: 接下来，我们通过监督微调（SFT）将算法2中得到的工作流 w t ∗ w_{t}^{*} 所引发的行为内化。

sents.en: For each training task t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}} , we execute 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ∗ , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{*};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}}) independently M M times, yielding candidate trajectory–workspace pairs { ( τ t , j , y t , j ) } j = 1 M \{(\tau_{t,j},y_{t,j})\}_{j=1}^{M} .
sents.zh: 对于每个训练任务 t ∈ 𝒯 train t\in\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{train}}，我们独立执行 𝒜 ⁡ ( x t ⊕ w t ∗ , ℒ agent ) {\mathcal{A}}(x_{t}\oplus w_{t}^{*};{\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{agent}}) M 次，得到候选的轨迹–工作空间对 { ( τ t , j , y t , j ) } j = 1 M \{(\tau_{t,j},y_{t,j})\}_{j=1}^{M}。

sents.en: Within each task, ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} compares pairs of deliverable workspaces y t , j 1 y_{t,{j_{1}}} and y t , j 2 y_{t,{j_{2}}} , where j 1 ≠ j 2 ∈ [ M ] j_{1}\neq j_{2}\in[M] , in a pairwise tournament.
sents.zh: 在每个任务中，ℒ eval {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{eval}} 通过两两对抗赛比较交付工作空间 y t , j 1 y_{t,{j_{1}}} 和 y t , j 2 y_{t,{j_{2}}}（其中 j 1 ≠ j 2 ∈ [ M ] j_{1}\neq j_{2}\in[M]）。

sents.en: A Bradley–Terry model converts these pairwise judgments into workspace-level scores.
sents.zh: 布拉德利–特里模型将这些两两判断转换为工作空间级别的得分。

sents.en: We rank the trajectory–workspace pairs by score, use the top K − 1 K-1 trajectories { τ t , j } j = 1 K − 1 \{\tau_{t,j}\}_{j=1}^{K-1} from each task as the SFT training set 𝒟 train {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{train}} , and reserve the K K th trajectory for the validation set 𝒟 val {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{val}} .
sents.zh: 我们按得分对轨迹–工作空间对进行排序，使用每个任务中排名前 K − 1 K-1 的轨迹 { τ t , j } j = 1 K − 1 \{\tau_{t,j}\}_{j=1}^{K-1} 作为 SFT 训练集 𝒟 train {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{train}}，并将第 K K 条轨迹保留在验证集 𝒟 val {\mathcal{D}}_{\mathrm{val}} 中。

sents.en: We remove w t ∗ w^{*}_{t} from the prompt for dataset construction.
sents.zh: 在数据集构建过程中，我们从提示中移除 w t ∗ w^{*}_{t}。

paragraphs.en: Models and tasks. Our base model ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} is Qwen3.6-27B-FP8, and we use qwen-code 0.20.0 as the coding agent 𝒜 {\mathcal{A}} . We use 12 synthetic research-programming (long-horizon) tasks (private benchmark) generated by GPT-5.5, with four tasks each in finance, robotics, and pharmacy ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Test tasks. Test tasks 𝒯 test \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{test}} consist of ScienceAgentBench (102 tasks) ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , MLR-Bench (107tasks) ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , DSBench ( Jing et al., 2025 ) , AstaBench E2E-Bench-hard ( Bragg et al., 2026 ) , Terminal-Bench 2.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) ,SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and three synthetic research tasks described above. Those three synthetic tasks are (1) The finance task asks the agent to backtest an equity long–short strategy on S&P 500 data from Yahoo Finance and estimate trading capacity after accounting for spreads, market impact, and borrowing costs. (2) Pharmacy task evaluates inverse-folding models on Protein Data Bank backbones against random and Markov baselines using sequence recovery and structure-quality proxies ( Berman et al., 2000 ) . (3) Robotics task requires constructing a tool-use manipulation benchmark using RoboTAP ( Vecerik et al., 2024 ) or custom PyBullet tasks and comparing symbolic planning with behavior cloning in terms of task success, tool selection, and failure modes. Each task requires reproducible code, quantitative results, and a research report.

paragraphs.en: Train data and post-training. In Algorithm 3 , we generate M = 18 M=18 candidate trajectories per task and select up to K = 16 K=16 teacher trajectories. One candidate training task is excluded because Algorithm 2 does not find a workflow that outperforms its reference. Across the remaining eight training tasks, the final training set contains ( 9 − 1 ) × 15 − 1 = 119 (9-1)\times 15-1=119 trajectories: up to 15 per task, with one trajectory excluded because the coding-agent harness terminated prematurely. More details are documented in Appendices B and B.1 .

paragraphs.en: The 119 teacher trajectories yield 2,435 training windows (282 orchestrator, 2,054 subagent, and 99 auxiliary), containing 17.2M supervised tokens. We set L max = 49,152 L_{\max}=49{,}152 tokens, with up to 8,192 8{,}192 tokens of preceding context retained but masked from the loss. Because subagent windows substantially outnumber orchestrator windows, we use a fixed 2 : 1 2{:}1 subagent-to-orchestrator sampling ratio. We train the BF16 parent model with a newly initialized LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2021 ) using rank 64, scaling factor 128, and dropout 0.05 0.05 . Optimization uses AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , a peak learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , five warmup steps, and cosine decay to 10 % 10\% of the peak learning rate, finally conducted 1,624 optimizer steps ( 3 3 windows/step).
paragraphs.zh: 119条教师轨迹生成了2,435个训练窗口（其中协调器窗口282个、子智能体窗口2,054个、辅助窗口99个），包含1720万个监督标记。 我们将L_max设为49,152个标记，同时保留最多8,192个前文上下文标记，但将其从损失函数中屏蔽。 由于子智能体窗口的数量远多于协调器窗口，我们采用固定的2:1子智能体与协调器的采样比例。 我们使用一个全新初始化的LoRA适配器（Hu等，2021）以BF16格式训练父模型，其中秩为64、缩放因子为128、丢弃率为0.05。 优化过程采用AdamW（Loshchilov和Hutter，2017），其中β_1=0.9、β_2=0.95，峰值学习率为3×10⁻⁵，包含五个预热步骤，并使用余弦衰减将学习率降至峰值的10%，最终执行了1,624次优化器步骤（每步处理3个窗口）。

sents.zh: 我们将L_max设为49,152个标记，同时保留最多8,192个前文上下文标记，但将其从损失函数中屏蔽。

sents.en: Because subagent windows substantially outnumber orchestrator windows, we use a fixed 2 : 1 2{:}1 subagent-to-orchestrator sampling ratio.
sents.zh: 由于子智能体窗口的数量远多于协调器窗口，我们采用固定的2:1子智能体与协调器的采样比例。

sents.en: We train the BF16 parent model with a newly initialized LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2021 ) using rank 64, scaling factor 128, and dropout 0.05 0.05 .
sents.zh: 我们使用一个全新初始化的LoRA适配器（Hu等，2021）以BF16格式训练父模型，其中秩为64、缩放因子为128、丢弃率为0.05。

sents.en: Optimization uses AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , a peak learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , five warmup steps, and cosine decay to 10 % 10\% of the peak learning rate, finally conducted 1,624 optimizer steps ( 3 3 windows/step).
sents.zh: 优化过程采用AdamW（Loshchilov和Hutter，2017），其中β_1=0.9、β_2=0.95，峰值学习率为3×10⁻⁵，包含五个预热步骤，并使用余弦衰减将学习率降至峰值的10%，最终执行了1,624次优化器步骤（每步处理3个窗口）。

paragraphs.en: External evaluation. We use OpenAI GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8, both at maximum reasoning effort, as external strong-model evaluators ℒ ext {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{ext}} . Each model is run with three independent seeds, yielding six judgments per workspace pair. paragraphs.en: Our first hypothesis is that optimizing how agents exchange information can provide useful self-supervision for RSI. We focus on two workflow components that directly control this information flow: the contract , which specifies what each subagent returns to the orchestrator, and the hop , which specifies the order in which subagents are called.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第一个假设是，优化智能体之间的信息交换方式，可以为 RSI 提供有效的自我监督。 我们重点关注直接控制这种信息流的两项工作流程组件：合同（contract），它规定了每个子智能体向协调器返回的内容；以及跳步（hop），它规定了子智能体的调用顺序。

sents.en: Our first hypothesis is that optimizing how agents exchange information can provide useful self-supervision for RSI.
sents.zh: 我们的第一个假设是，优化智能体之间的信息交换方式，可以为 RSI 提供有效的自我监督。

sents.en: We focus on two workflow components that directly control this information flow: the contract , which specifies what each subagent returns to the orchestrator, and the hop , which specifies the order in which subagents are called.
sents.zh: 我们重点关注直接控制这种信息流的两项工作流程组件：合同（contract），它规定了每个子智能体向协调器返回的内容；以及跳步（hop），它规定了子智能体的调用顺序。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the best retained workflow for each task in iteration i ∈ { 3 , 6 , 9 , 11 } i\in\{3,6,9,11\} and track four workflow components c ∈ { role , instruction , contract , hop } c\in\{\text{role},\text{instruction},\text{contract},\text{hop}\} . We measure two properties of these components. First, task information measures how much a component internalized the task. A component that varies strongly across tasks carries high task information, whereas a generic component shared across tasks carries little. We estimate this using mutual information I ^ i \widehat{I}_{i} between component embeddings ( Z c Z_{c} ) and task-description embeddings ( T ) (T) . Second, component redundancy measures how much information is shared among workflow components. High redundancy indicates that different components encode overlapping information, while lower redundancy suggests that they capture more distinct aspects of the workflow. We estimate this using total correlation T ​ C ^ \widehat{{TC}} among all four components. We also report a task-centered version that removes average task-specific effects before measuring redundancy, isolating overlap beyond shared task identity. We compute these statistics using two text-embedding models, text-embedding-3-large ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and all-mpnet-base-v2 ( Song et al., 2020 ) , and report both unadjusted and permutation-adjusted estimates. Full definitions are provided in Appendix F .

sents.en: We measure two properties of these components.

sents.en: First, task information measures how much a component internalized the task.
sents.zh: 首先，任务信息衡量一个组件对任务的内部化程度。

sents.en: A component that varies strongly across tasks carries high task information, whereas a generic component shared across tasks carries little.
sents.zh: 在不同任务间差异较大的组件具有高的任务信息，而跨任务共享的通用组件则具有较低的任务信息。

sents.en: Second, component redundancy measures how much information is shared among workflow components.
sents.zh: 其次，组件冗余度衡量工作流组件之间共享的信息量。

sents.en: High redundancy indicates that different components encode overlapping information, while lower redundancy suggests that they capture more distinct aspects of the workflow.
sents.zh: 高冗余度表明不同组件编码了重叠的信息，而较低的冗余度则说明它们捕捉了工作流中更多独立的不同方面。

sents.en: We also report a task-centered version that removes average task-specific effects before measuring redundancy, isolating overlap beyond shared task identity.
sents.zh: 我们还报告了一个以任务为中心的版本：在测量冗余度之前，先移除平均任务特定效应，从而隔离出超越共享任务身份的重叠部分。

paragraphs.en: Across workflow optimization, roles and instructions become less task-specific, while contracts and hops become more task-specific (Figure 5 ). At the same time, component redundancy generally decreases (Figure 5 ). These results suggest our first hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 在工作流优化过程中，角色和指令变得不那么针对特定任务，而合同和跳转则变得更加针对特定任务（图 5）。 与此同时，组件冗余通常也会减少（图 5）。 这些结果支持了我们的第一个假设。

paragraphs.en: Our second hypothesis is that jointly training orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories provides more effective supervision per teacher token than training on long-horizon single-agent trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第二个假设是，从多智能体轨迹中联合训练编排和受限子智能体执行，相比基于长时程单智能体轨迹的训练，能够为单位教师令牌提供更有效的监督。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 compares win rate against ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} as a function of processed supervised tokens during SFT. The single-agent reference interpolates the observed results for S S (1.82M tokens, 44.0 % 44.0\% ), S + S^{+} (9.11M, 59.0 % 59.0\% ), and S + ⁣ + S^{++} (42M, 64.0 % 64.0\% ). Both M M and M + M^{+} exceed this piecewise-linear reference at their respective token budgets by 8.3 and 6.3 percentage points. More directly, M + M^{+} reaches 68.3 % 68.3\% with 28.82M processed supervised tokens, 4.3 points above S + ⁣ + S^{++} while using 31.4 % 31.4\% fewer tokens. These results support higher performance per training token for multi-agent supervision in these runs.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 比较了 SFT 期间，随着已处理监督令牌数量的变化，胜率与 ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} 的关系。 单智能体参考模型对 S S（182 万令牌，44.0 % 44.0\%）、S + S^{+}（911 万，59.0 % 59.0\%）以及 S + ⁣ + S^{++}（4200 万，64.0 % 64.0\%）的观察结果进行了内插。 M M 和 M + M^{+} 在各自的令牌预算下，均比该分段线性参考模型高出 8.3 和 6.3 个百分点。 更直接地说，M + M^{+} 在使用 2882 万已处理监督令牌时达到了 68.3 % 68.3\%，比 S + ⁣ + S^{++} 高出 4.3 个百分点，而使用的令牌数量却少了 31.4 % 31.4\%。 这些结果表明，在这些运行中，多智能体监督方式在单位训练令牌上的性能更高。

paragraphs.en: Data quality may also contribute to this advantage. Multi-agent executions generate approximately 2.4 × 2.4\times more tokens on average than single-agent executions and are preferred in 85.1 % 85.1\% of external judgments overall. Among the 10 episode pairs with similar generated trace lengths, the multi-agent preference remains 80.0 % 80.0\% (Appendix D.3 ). This suggests that the quality advantage is not explained solely by longer inference.
paragraphs.zh: 数据质量也可能对这一优势有所贡献。 多智能体执行平均生成的标记数量约为单智能体执行的 2.4 × 2.4\times 倍，并且在所有外部评估中，有 85.1 % 85.1\% 的情况更倾向于选择多智能体执行。 在 10 对生成轨迹长度相近的实例中，多智能体的偏好比例仍为 80.0 % 80.0\%（附录 D.3）。 这表明，质量优势并非仅由更长的推理过程所导致。

paragraphs.en: A plausible mechanism is the separation of prediction problems: the orchestrator maps a task and prior results to a bounded assignment, while a subagent maps that assignment and its artifact inputs to an implementation. Both losses update the same parameters θ \theta , jointly training coordination and local execution. Learning these complementary prediction problems at different levels of abstraction motivates our second hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 一种合理的机制是预测问题的分离：协调器将任务和历史结果映射到一个有界分配上，而子智能体则将该分配及其产物输入映射到具体实现上。 两种损失函数共同更新相同的参数 θ \theta ，从而联合训练协调与局部执行能力。 在不同抽象层次上学习这些互补的预测问题，正是我们第二个假设的出发点。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, improved workflow reachability (Figure 7(a) ) does not guarantee stable optimization (Figure 7(b) ): strong iterations can be followed by sharp performance regressions. We further analyze the size of successive workflow edits and find little Spearman correlation between textual edit size and the change in verdicts ( | ρ edit | ≤ 0.12 |\rho_{\mathrm{edit}}|\leq 0.12 ). Near-unanimous outcomes also reverse under both small and large edits. Thus, the magnitude of the textual change from w t ( 0 , i − 1 ) w_{t}^{(0,i-1)} to w t ( 0 , i ) w_{t}^{(0,i)} is a weak predictor of the resulting performance change (Table 10 from Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 有趣的是，工作流可达性的提升（图 7(a)）并不保证优化的稳定性（图 7(b)）：强烈的迭代之后可能会出现性能急剧下降。 我们进一步分析了连续工作流编辑的大小，发现文本编辑大小与判决变化之间的斯皮尔曼相关性极小（|ρ_edit| ≤ 0.12）。 在小型和大型编辑下，几乎一致的结果也会发生逆转。 因此，从 w_t^{(0,i-1)} 到 w_t^{(0,i)} 的文本变化幅度，对由此产生的性能变化而言是一个较弱的预测指标（见附录 E 中的表 10）。

sents.en: Interestingly, improved workflow reachability (Figure 7(a) ) does not guarantee stable optimization (Figure 7(b) ): strong iterations can be followed by sharp performance regressions.

sents.en: We further analyze the size of successive workflow edits and find little Spearman correlation between textual edit size and the change in verdicts ( | ρ edit | ≤ 0.12 |\rho_{\mathrm{edit}}|\leq 0.12 ).
sents.zh: 我们进一步分析了连续工作流编辑的大小，发现文本编辑大小与判决变化之间的斯皮尔曼相关性极小（|ρ_edit| ≤ 0.12）。

sents.en: Near-unanimous outcomes also reverse under both small and large edits.
sents.zh: 在小型和大型编辑下，几乎一致的结果也会发生逆转。

sents.en: Thus, the magnitude of the textual change from w t ( 0 , i − 1 ) w_{t}^{(0,i-1)} to w t ( 0 , i ) w_{t}^{(0,i)} is a weak predictor of the resulting performance change (Table 10 from Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 因此，从 w_t^{(0,i-1)} 到 w_t^{(0,i)} 的文本变化幅度，对由此产生的性能变化而言是一个较弱的预测指标（见附录 E 中的表 10）。

paragraphs.en: We test behavioral internalization in two ways: whether the trained model exhibits coordination under bare task prompts, and whether these behaviors were present in its SFT data. Delegation ( D D ) means that the orchestrator calls a subagent and the call returns without a tool error. A code handoff ( H H ) occurs when a subagent successfully reads a Python file whose latest recorded writer is a different subagent that has already returned. We also audit subagent revisions and orchestrator edits (full definitions in Appendix G ). Delegation rises from 1/110 trajectories for ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} to 48/110 for ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} and 87/110 for ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} , while code handoffs rise from 1/110 to 42/110 and 83/110, respectively. These behaviors emerge without providing the optimized workflow at inference time. These behaviors are also directly represented in the SFT data. Among 114 audited teacher trajectories, 98 contain code handoffs and 57 contain subagent revisions; 79 and 37 of these trajectories, respectively, were sampled for SFT (Appendix G.2 ). Together, these suggest that post-training internalizes coordination behaviors from multi-agent trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种方式测试行为内化：训练后的模型在仅给出任务提示时是否表现出协作行为，以及这些行为是否出现在其 SFT 数据中。 委托（ D D ）意味着协调器调用一个子智能体，且该调用返回时未出现工具错误。 当子智能体成功读取一个 Python 文件，而该文件的最新记录写入者是一个已经返回的不同子智能体时，就会发生代码移交（ H H ）。 我们还审计了子智能体的修订和协调器的编辑（完整定义见附录 G）。 委托的比例从 ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} 的 1/110 个轨迹上升到 ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} 的 48/110 和 ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} 的 87/110，而代码移交的比例则分别从 1/110 上升到 42/110 和 83/110。 这些行为在推理阶段无需提供优化后的工作流程即可出现。 这些行为也直接反映在 SFT 数据中。 在审计的 114 条教师轨迹中，有 98 条包含代码移交，57 条包含子智能体修订；其中分别有 79 条和 37 条轨迹被用于 SFT 采样（附录 G.2）。 综合来看，这些结果表明训练后的模型内化了多智能体轨迹中的协作行为。

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement and workflow optimization. Schmidhuber studied self-referential weight modification ( Schmidhuber, 1993 ) , reward-based policy changes ( Schmidhuber et al., 1997 ) , and proof-gated self-rewriting in Gödel machines ( Schmidhuber, 2007 ) . MASS uses empirical workflow search and SFT without formal guarantees. Self-Rewarding LMs train on self-scored responses ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , while SiriuS trains on selected multi-agent traces ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Multi-Agent Evolve trains a shared proposer, solver, and judge ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . ADAS, AFlow, and GPTSwarm optimize agent designs and communication graphs ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . RHI revises workflow prompts ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . TTHE uses one frozen backbone for execution, harness proposals, and judging ( Nie et al., 2026 ) , exemplifying homogeneous in-loop roles. At inference time, communicating agents share discoveries ( Park et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进与工作流程优化。 Schmidhuber 研究了自指性权重修改（Schmidhuber，1993）、基于奖励的策略调整（Schmidhuber 等，1997），以及哥德尔机器中的证明门控式自我重写（Schmidhuber，2007）。 MASS 使用经验性工作流程搜索和 SFT，但没有形式化保证。 自奖励语言模型基于自我评分的响应进行训练（Yuan 等，2024），而 SiriuS 则基于精选的多智能体轨迹进行训练（Zhao 等，2026）。 Multi-Agent Evolve 训练一个共享的提议者、解决者和评判者（Chen 等，2025a）。 ADAS、AFlow 和 GPTSwarm 优化了智能体设计和通信图（Hu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025；Zhuge 等，2024）。 RHI 修订工作流程提示（Lee 等，2026）。 TTHE 使用一个冻结的主干网络进行执行、利用提议和评判（Nie 等，2026），体现了循环内同质化的角色分工。 在推理阶段，相互通信的智能体会共享发现成果（Park 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Model–workflow co-evolution. SIA updates scaffolds and weights using a separate feedback model and task verifiers ( Hebbar et al., 2026 ) ; HASE jointly learns solutions and harness edits with task rewards ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . HELIX generates verified training records without reported weight updates ( Fan and Huang, 2026 ) . MASS distills optimized workflows’ orchestrator and subagent traces into shared weights and reuses the student in three roles. Appendix J further compares related works.
paragraphs.zh: 模型–工作流协同演化。 SIA 使用独立的反馈模型和任务验证器更新脚手架和权重（Hebbar 等，2026）；HASE 则通过任务奖励联合学习解决方案和 harness 编辑（Luo 等，2026）。 HELIX 生成经过验证的训练记录，但未报告权重更新（Fan 和 Huang，2026）。 MASS 将优化工作流的协调器和子智能体轨迹蒸馏为共享权重，并将学生模型重新用于三种角色。 J 附录进一步比较了相关研究。

paragraphs.en: We study recursive self-improvement (RSI) when the same LLM serves as the agent, optimizer, and evaluator. Because this homogeneous loop shares a learned prior, it risks reinforcing its own errors rather than correcting them. Drawing on the Society of Mind, we address this by forming a multi-agent system from multiple copies of the model and distilling their collective gains as self-supervision, and we show this provides useful self-supervision in RSI. Accelerating the speed of these performance gains in each cycle remains an important direction for future works.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了递归自我改进（RSI）的情况，即同一个大型语言模型同时充当智能体、优化器和评估者。 由于这种同构循环共享一个已学习的先验知识，它可能会强化自身的错误，而非纠正这些错误。 借鉴《心智社会》的理论，我们通过将模型的多个副本组成一个多智能体系统来解决这个问题，并将它们的集体成果提炼为自我监督信号；我们证明了这种方法能为递归自我改进提供有效的自我监督。 加快每个周期中性能提升的速度，仍然是未来研究的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: The private benchmark contains 12 research-programming tasks, with four each in finance, pharmacy, and robotics ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Nine are designated for training. Task 221 is excluded from teacher collection because workflow search finds no workflow that beats its reference, leaving eight tasks that contribute SFT data (Table 3 ). The other three tasks are held out from SFT, validation, and checkpoint selection. Workflow search is also evaluated on these tasks; the split refers to post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 该私有基准包含 12 项研究编程任务，其中金融、药学和机器人领域各有四项（Lee et al., 2026）。 九项任务被指定用于训练。 任务 221 未被纳入教师集，因为流程搜索未能找到任何优于其参考流程的流程，因此剩余八项任务贡献了 SFT 数据（表 3）。 其余三项任务则保留在 SFT、验证和检查点选择之外。 流程搜索也在这几项任务上进行评估；该划分指的是训练后的阶段。

paragraphs.en: We reconstruct each recorded conversation, retaining its system prompt, tool definitions, messages, and assistant outputs. In the orchestrator conversation, the initial task–workflow–directive prompt is replaced with the bare task. Worker assignments remain unchanged. Windows contain at most 49,152 tokens, including up to 8,192 tokens of preceding context. Only assistant reasoning, text, and tool calls carry loss; system and user messages, tool outputs, and overlapping context are masked.

paragraphs.en: The first-cycle training set contains 119 trajectories, yielding 2,435 windows: 282 orchestrator, 2,054 worker, and 99 auxiliary windows, with 17,221,055 supervised tokens. Auxiliary windows are additional runtime conversations outside the orchestrator and general-purpose worker roles. For each draw, we sample a task uniformly, choose an orchestrator window with probability 1 / 3 1/3 or a worker/auxiliary window with probability 2 / 3 2/3 , and sample a window uniformly within that group, with replacement. Thus, two nominal epochs specify a draw budget, not two visits to every stored window.
paragraphs.zh: 第一周期训练集包含 119 条轨迹，由此生成 2,435 个窗口：282 个协调器窗口、2,054 个执行者窗口和 99 个辅助窗口，共包含 17,221,055 个监督词元。 辅助窗口是位于协调器和通用执行者角色之外的额外运行时对话。 对于每次抽取，我们以均匀分布采样一个任务，以 1 / 3 的概率选择一个协调器窗口，或以 2 / 3 的概率选择一个执行者/辅助窗口，然后在该组内以均匀分布且可重复的方式采样一个窗口。 因此，两个名义上的周期指定了一个抽取预算，而不是对每个已存储窗口进行两次访问。

sents.en: Thus, two nominal epochs specify a draw budget, not two visits to every stored window.
sents.zh: 因此，两个名义上的周期指定了一个抽取预算，而不是对每个已存储窗口进行两次访问。

paragraphs.en: We train the BF16 parent model with a fresh LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2021 ) : rank 64, scaling factor 128, and dropout 0.05. AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) uses β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , peak learning rate 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , five warmup steps, and cosine decay to 10% of the peak rate. The first-cycle run has 1,624 optimizer steps with three windows per step. Checkpoints are saved every 50 steps; validation loss is measured initially, every 150 steps, and at the end.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个新的 LoRA 适配器（Hu et al., 2021）来训练 BF16 父模型：秩为 64，缩放因子为 128，丢弃率为 0.05。 AdamW（Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017）使用 β₁ = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9、β₂ = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95、峰值学习率 3 × 10⁻⁵ 3\times 10^{-5}、五个预热步骤，以及将学习率按余弦衰减至峰值的 10%。 第一轮的运行包含 1,624 个优化器步骤，每个步骤有三个窗口。 检查点每 50 步保存一次；验证损失在初始阶段、每 150 步以及最后进行测量。

paragraphs.en: We select the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss, using assistant-token cross-entropy with the same masking rules as SFT. The first-cycle student uses step 1200. The selected adapter is merged into the parent model and quantized to block-FP8 for inference. External workspace judgments do not select the checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择验证损失最低的检查点，并使用与 SFT 相同的掩码规则计算助手标记的交叉熵。 第一周期的学生使用第 1200 步。 选定的适配器会合并到主模型中，并在推理时量化为块级 FP8。 外部工作空间的判断不会选择检查点。

paragraphs.en: Training uses six NVIDIA H100 GPUs, arranged as three data-parallel replicas of two GPUs each. The first-cycle SFT run takes about 19 hours, including validation. This is the SFT runtime, not the cost of workflow search, teacher collection, and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 训练使用了六块 NVIDIA H100 GPU，以每组两块 GPU 的三种数据并行副本形式进行排列。 第一轮的 SFT 运行（包括验证）大约需要 19 小时。 这是 SFT 的运行时间，而非工作流搜索、教师模型收集与评估的成本。

We initialize a fresh LoRA adapter on the merged first-cycle model and follow the same training recipe as closely as possible. Checkpoint selection uses validation loss, as in the first cycle.

paragraphs.en: 1 ## Execution requirements for the agent team (mandatory) 2 3 1. Run the team for real. Every non-orchestrator role listed above must be executed as a separate sub-agent through the `agent` tool (subagent_type "general-purpose"). Simulating a role in your own turn does not count. You, the orchestrator, do not write pipeline or analysis code yourself; you set up the project, delegate, verify, and integrate. 4 5 2. Foreground only. Every `agent` call must set `run_in_background: false`, so the worker’s report comes back before you continue. Never launch background agents. 6 7 3. One stage at a time. Launch a worker only when the inputs it needs already exist on disk. Launch several workers in one turn only if their tasks are independent and they write to disjoint files. 8 9 4. Self-contained instructions. A worker sees nothing but your prompt and the filesystem. Each prompt must include: the role’s instruction from the team definition above; the absolute workspace path; the exact files to create or modify; the interfaces or artifacts produced by earlier stages that it must use; the command(s) to run to verify its work; and the report you expect back (files written, commands run with results, key numbers, known problems). 10 11 5. Verify before you build on it. After each report, check the worker’s output yourself (run the entry point, inspect the artifacts). If the check fails or the report shows problems, re-delegate to the same role with a corrected, narrower instruction instead of fixing it yourself. 12 13 6. Bounded work. Give each worker one deliverable it can finish in a single run: a handful of files and one verification command. Split large roles into several sequential calls. 14 15 7. Finish cleanly. Do not end your turn while a worker is running. Your final answer must summarize every worker call: role, what it was asked, status, and what you verified.
paragraphs.zh: 1 ## 智能体团队的执行要求（强制性） 2 3 1. 真实运行该团队。 上述列出的每个非协调者角色都必须通过 `agent` 工具作为独立的子智能体执行（subagent_type "general-purpose"）。 在自己的回合中模拟某个角色不算数。 你作为协调者，不要自己编写流程或分析代码；你需要设置项目、分配任务、验证并整合结果。 4 5 2. 仅在前台运行。 每次调用 `agent` 都必须设置 `run_in_background: false`，这样工作者报告返回后你才能继续执行。 永远不要启动后台智能体。 6 7 3. 一次一个阶段。 只有在工作者所需的输入已经存在于磁盘上时，才启动它。 仅当多个工作者的任务相互独立且它们写入的文件互不重叠时，才在一个回合中启动多个工作者。 8 9 4. 自包含的指令。 工作者只能看到你的提示和文件系统。 每个提示必须包括：来自上述团队定义的角色指令；绝对工作区路径；需要创建或修改的确切文件；早期阶段产生的、它必须使用的接口或成果；用于验证其工作的命令；以及你期望返回的报告（已写入的文件、执行过的命令及结果、关键数值、已知问题）。 10 11 5. 在基于其结果继续操作前，先进行验证。 每次收到报告后，都要亲自检查工作者的输出（运行入口点，检查成果）。 如果检查失败或报告显示存在问题，应重新向同一角色分配经过修正且范围更窄的指令，而不是自行修复。 12 13 6. 有限的工作量。 为每个工作者分配一个单次运行即可完成的任务：少量文件和一条验证命令。 将大型角色拆分为多个顺序调用的任务。 14 15 7. 干净地结束。 不要在工作者仍在运行时结束你的回合。 你的最终答案必须总结每次工作者的调用：角色、被要求执行的任务、状态以及你验证的内容。

paragraphs.en: In homogeneous MASS, the current model supplies feedback for workflow optimization and judgments for teacher ranking. Validation loss selects the checkpoint. The external panel assesses the resulting workspaces after execution (Table 4 ). Its verdicts and rationales are withheld from the agents and workflow optimizer and are not SFT targets. Evaluator agreement is computed after the self-evaluator has made its predictions without access to the external judgments. The teacher-composition controls use the separate checkpoint-selection procedure in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 在均质 MASS 中，当前模型为工作流程优化提供反馈，并为教师排名提供判断依据。 验证损失用于选择检查点。 外部评审小组在执行后评估生成的工作区（表 4）。 其判定结果和理由不会透露给智能体和工作流程优化器，且不属于 SFT 目标。 在自我评估器完成预测且无法访问外部判断后，计算评估者的一致性。 教师组合控制使用附录 D 中的独立检查点选择程序。

paragraphs.en: Unless stated otherwise, each workspace pair receives six judgments: GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 at maximum reasoning effort, each with seeds 42, 43, and 44. Win share is W / ( W + L ) W/(W+L) , excluding ties. These are repeated assessments of one pair of outputs, not six independent task executions. We report descriptive shares and do not infer statistical significance from the number of judgments.

paragraphs.en: We use the 102-task verified split of ScienceAgentBench ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , an OpenHands-style instruction without expert knowledge, per-task containers based on the official evaluator image, and a 30-minute agent limit. The official dockerized evaluator determines task success by executing the submitted program and checking its outputs. We evaluate each model in three trials. For each model, we compute the unweighted mean and sample standard deviation of its three trial-level success rates and report both as percentages in Table 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 ScienceAgentBench（Chen 等人，2025b）中经过 102 个任务验证的划分方案，采用 OpenHands 风格的指令（不含专家知识）、基于官方评估器镜像的按任务划分的容器，以及 30 分钟的智能体运行时限。 官方容器化的评估器通过执行提交的程序并检查其输出结果来判断任务是否成功。 我们对每个模型进行了三次试验评估。 对于每个模型，我们计算了其三次试验成功率在未加权平均值和样本标准差，并将两者以百分比形式报告在表 7 中。

sents.en: We use the 102-task verified split of ScienceAgentBench ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , an OpenHands-style instruction without expert knowledge, per-task containers based on the official evaluator image, and a 30-minute agent limit.

sents.zh: 官方容器化的评估器通过执行提交的程序并检查其输出结果来判断任务是否成功。

sents.en: For each model, we compute the unweighted mean and sample standard deviation of its three trial-level success rates and report both as percentages in Table 7 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a 12-task subset of MLR-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . The tasks cover ICLR 2023 domain generalization; ICLR 2024 data-centric ML and generative/experimental ML; ICLR 2025 financial AI; ICML 2023 learning, control, and dynamics; ICML 2024 AI for science; NeurIPS 2023 differential equations, goal-conditioned RL, heavy tails, and temporal graphs; and NeurIPS 2024 materials and optimization. Each run combines the benchmark’s stage instructions into one end-to-end task: propose an idea, write a proposal, run experiments, and write a paper. The agent has two hours, three CPU cores, 16 GB RAM, and no GPU for its experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 MLR-Bench（Chen 等人，2026）中一个包含 12 个任务的子集。 这些任务涵盖了 ICLR 2023 的领域泛化；ICLR 2024 的数据中心式机器学习与生成/实验性机器学习；ICLR 2025 的金融人工智能；ICML 2023 的学习、控制与动力学；ICML 2024 的科学研究用人工智能；NeurIPS 2023 的微分方程、目标条件强化学习、重尾分布和时间图；以及 NeurIPS 2024 的材料与优化。 每次运行都将基准测试的各个阶段指令整合为一个端到端任务：提出一个想法、撰写提案、进行实验并撰写论文。 该智能体在实验中拥有两小时时间、三个 CPU 核心、16 GB RAM，但没有 GPU。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 each review the task, paper, and saved code using the official MLR-Judge overall-review rubric. We average their Overall scores on the 1–10 scale. A missing paper, or a paper.md file shorter than 200 bytes, receives zero. The higher aggregate score for ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} accompanies more delivered papers: 31 / 60 31/60 , 36 / 60 36/60 , and 50 / 60 50/60 for generations 0, 1, and 2. Mean scores among delivered papers are 3.07, 3.00, and 2.88. These conditional means refer to different sets of completed tasks; they do not measure a quality change on a common completed set. The aggregate score improvement therefore accompanies higher completion. None of the 180 MLR-Bench executions calls the delegation tool, so this result does not establish delegation as the mechanism of public-benchmark transfer.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.8 均使用官方 MLR-Judge 总体评审评分标准，对任务、论文和已保存的代码进行评审。 我们对它们在 1–10 分制上的总体得分求平均值。 如果缺少论文，或 paper.md 文件长度不足 200 字节，则得分为零。 ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} 的更高综合得分伴随着更多已交付的论文：第 0、1 和 2 次生成分别交付了 31 / 60 31/60、36 / 60 36/60 和 50 / 60 50/60 篇论文。 已交付论文的平均得分分别为 3.07、3.00 和 2.88。 这些条件均值对应不同的已完成任务集合；它们并未衡量同一组已完成任务的质量变化。 因此，综合得分的提升伴随着更高的任务完成率。 在 180 次 MLR-Bench 执行中，没有任何一次调用了委托工具，因此这一结果并未证明委托是公共基准测试迁移的机制。

paragraphs.en: For MLR-Bench, two-sided Welch t t -tests on the five trial means give p = 0.0053 p=0.0053 for ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} versus ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} , p = 0.0109 p=0.0109 for ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} versus ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} , and p = 0.3430 p=0.3430 for ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} versus ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} . Two-sided Fisher exact tests on pooled paper-delivery counts give p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 , 0.0079 0.0079 , and 0.4623 0.4623 for the same comparisons. These are exploratory comparisons; the pooled counts repeat the same tasks, and Welch’s test does not use the matched seeds. Paired, two-sided exact sign tests across the 12 task-mean scores give p = 0.2266 p=0.2266 , 0.2266 0.2266 , and 0.5488 0.5488 , respectively. The evidence for improvement therefore depends on the aggregation unit, and does not establish a consistent gain across research tasks.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the 40-task Hard test split of AstaBench ( Bragg et al., 2026 ) in three trials per model. Each task asks the agent to implement a research idea, run experiments, and write a report. Runs use the benchmark’s sandbox with Python 3.11, two CPU cores, 48 GB RAM, no GPU, and a two-hour limit. The official rubric judge (Claude Sonnet 4.6, temperature 0) scores the report and code against the task’s checklist. The score is the fraction of checklist items satisfied; a missing report receives zero. The scaffold does not call AstaBench’s literature-search tool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 AstaBench（Bragg 等人，2026）的 40 项任务“Hard”测试集进行三次试验评估，每个模型各一次。 每项任务都要求智能体实现一个研究构想、运行实验并撰写报告。 运行过程使用基准测试的沙盒环境，配置为 Python 3.11、两个 CPU 核心、48 GB RAM、无 GPU，且限时两小时。 官方评分标准裁判（Claude Sonnet 4.6，温度设为 0）根据任务检查清单对报告和代码进行评分。 得分为满足检查清单项数的比例；若未提交报告，则得分为零。 该框架不会调用 AstaBench 的文献搜索工具。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the 74 data-modeling tasks of DSBench ( Jing et al., 2025 ) in three trials per model. Each task provides a competition description, training and test data, and a sample submission. The agent has one hour, two CPU cores, and 16 GB RAM to produce a CSV file of test-set predictions. Experiments run without a GPU. The official competition-specific evaluator scores the predictions against hidden test labels, with a ten-minute evaluation limit. We normalize each raw metric so that the benchmark’s baseline maps to zero and its best-human reference maps to one, and clip negative normalized scores to zero. Missing or invalid predictions receive zero. Each trial score averages all 74 normalized task scores. The means and sample standard deviations over three trials are 0.473 ± 0.029 0.473\pm 0.029 , 0.465 ± 0.011 0.465\pm 0.011 , and 0.482 ± 0.025 0.482\pm 0.025 for ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} , ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} , and ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 DSBench（Jing 等人，2025）中的 74 个数据建模任务进行每模型三次试验的评估。 每个任务都提供竞赛说明、训练和测试数据以及一个提交样本。 智能体有一小时时间、两个 CPU 核心和 16 GB RAM 来生成包含测试集预测结果的 CSV 文件。 实验在无需 GPU 的情况下运行。 官方竞赛专用评估器根据隐藏测试标签对预测结果进行评分，评估时限为十分钟。 我们将每个原始指标进行归一化处理，使基准的基线对应于零，其最佳人类参考值对应于一，并将负值的归一化分数截断为零。 缺失或无效的预测将得到零分。 每次试验的得分是全部 74 个归一化任务得分的平均值。 三次试验的平均值和样本标准差分别为 0.473 ± 0.029 0.473\pm 0.029、0.465 ± 0.011 0.465\pm 0.011 和 0.482 ± 0.025 0.482\pm 0.025，分别对应 ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)}、ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} 和 ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)}。

paragraphs.en: We run the 89 tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) in three trials per model using Harbor 0.23.0. Each task runs in its container with the official task-specific agent and verifier time limits. Hidden tests assign a binary pass or fail. Within each trial, we report scores on the tasks with a recorded verifier result for all three models; a task missing any model’s result is excluded from all three. This gives 86, 88, and 87 scored tasks in trials 1, 2, and 3. Agent timeouts are not rerun. We compute the unweighted mean and sample standard deviation of the three trial pass rates. In percentages, the results are 37.5 ± 2.2 37.5\pm 2.2 , 35.3 ± 2.1 35.3\pm 2.1 , and 35.2 ± 1.7 35.2\pm 1.7 for ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} , ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} , and ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Harbor 0.23.0，在 Terminal-Bench 2.0（Merrill 等人，2026）中针对每个模型运行 89 项任务，共进行三次试验。 每项任务都在其容器中运行，并使用官方指定的特定任务智能体和验证器时间限制。 隐藏测试会给出通过或失败的二元结果。 在每次试验中，我们对所有三个模型报告各项任务的得分以及记录下来的验证器结果；若某项任务缺少任一模型的结果，则从所有三个模型的结果中排除该任务。 因此，第一次、第二次和第三次试验中分别有 86、88 和 87 项任务被计入评分。 智能体超时后不会重新运行。 我们计算三次试验通过率的无加权平均值和样本标准差。 以百分比表示，结果分别为 ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} 的 37.5 ± 2.2 37.5\pm 2.2、ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} 的 35.3 ± 2.1 35.3\pm 2.1，以及 ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} 的 35.2 ± 1.7 35.2\pm 1.7。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the 500-instance Verified subset of SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) in three trials per model. Each instance provides a repository and a GitHub issue; the agent must produce a code patch. Runs use the benchmark’s per-instance container images through Harbor, with a 50-minute agent limit, one CPU core, and 4 GB RAM. The official test suite checks that the patch fixes the reported failure and preserves previously passing tests, yielding a binary result. As for Terminal-Bench, each trial uses the tasks with recorded verifier results for all three models. The denominators are 499, 499, and 496 in trials 1, 2, and 3; agent timeouts are not rerun. The unweighted means and sample standard deviations of the three trial pass rates are 62.6 ± 1.4 % 62.6\pm 1.4\% , 61.8 ± 1.9 % 61.8\pm 1.9\% , and 61.1 ± 0.6 % 61.1\pm 0.6\% for ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)} , ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} , and ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 SWE-bench 的 500 个实例组成的 Verified 子集（Jimenez 等人，2024）进行每模型三次试验的评估。 每个实例都提供一个代码库和一个 GitHub 问题；智能体必须生成一个代码补丁。 运行过程通过 Harbor 使用基准测试为每个实例提供的容器镜像，智能体的运行时间限制为 50 分钟，配备一个 CPU 核心和 4 GB RAM。 官方测试套件会检查该补丁是否修复了报告的问题，同时保持先前通过的测试通过，从而得出一个二元结果。 与 Terminal-Bench 类似，每次试验都会使用所有三种模型已记录验证结果的任务。 第一次、第二次和第三次试验的分母分别为 499、499 和 496；智能体超时后不会重新运行。 三次试验的通过率未经加权平均值和样本标准差分别为：对于 ℒ ( 0 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(0)}，为 62.6 ± 1.4 % 62.6\pm 1.4\%；对于 ℒ ( 1 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(1)}，为 61.8 ± 1.9 % 61.8\pm 1.9\%；对于 ℒ ( 2 ) {\mathcal{L}}^{(2)}，为 61.1 ± 0.6 % 61.1\pm 0.6\%。

paragraphs.en: The controls share the parent model, adapter architecture, and core SFT hyperparameters. For S , M , X S,M,X , and S + S^{+} , the sampler chooses a task–prompt combination uniformly, then a window within that group, with replacement; an optimizer step processes two windows. M + M^{+} instead uses the task/role sampler and three windows per step in Appendix B.2 . For ( S , M , X S,M,X ), and ( S + S^{+} ), checkpoint selection compares the final checkpoint with a saved checkpoint near 80% of training. Each candidate is evaluated using two reserved-seed rollouts on each of tasks 51, 53, 56, and 307. Task 60 is excluded from checkpoint selection. The main MASS student M + M^{+} uses validation-loss selection. These differences in sampling, data, and checkpoint selection limit what can be attributed to teacher composition alone.
paragraphs.zh: 控制部分共享父模型、适配器架构以及核心 SFT 超参数。 对于 S、M、X S,M,X 以及 S + S^{+}，采样器以均匀方式选择一个任务–提示组合，然后在该组内重复选择一个窗口；一个优化步骤处理两个窗口。 M + M^{+} 则使用任务/角色采样器，并在附录 B.2 中每个步骤处理三个窗口。 对于 ( S , M , X S,M,X ) 和 ( S + S^{+} )，检查点选择会将最终检查点与训练接近 80% 时保存的检查点进行对比。 每个候选模型都使用两个保留种子的展开过程，在任务 51、53、56 和 307 上进行评估。 任务 60 不参与检查点选择。 主要的 MASS 学生模型 M + M^{+} 使用验证损失进行选择。 采样、数据和检查点选择的这些差异，限制了我们仅能归因于教师模型构成的部分。

paragraphs.en: This retrospective comparison examines base-model outputs on the eight training tasks. Single-agent episodes receive a workflow without the execution directive and make no worker calls. Multi-agent episodes receive a workflow and the directive in Appendix B.3 . Both groups require successful completion and at least 0.6 deliverable coverage; the multi-agent group also requires completed foreground workers. This analysis is separate from selecting the final SFT dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 这项回顾性比较检验了基础模型在八个训练任务上的输出。 单智能体回合会获得一个没有执行指令的工作流，并且不会调用任何工作者。 多智能体回合会获得一个工作流以及附录 B.3 中的指令。 两组都需要成功完成任务且成果覆盖率达到至少 0.6；多智能体组还要求前景工作者已完成。 这项分析与最终 SFT 数据集的选择无关。

paragraphs.en: Generated trace length sums completion tokens over every API request in an episode, including the orchestrator and all workers: N gen ​ ( e ) = ∑ j ∈ 𝒥 e n j out N_{\mathrm{gen}}(e)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal{J}_{e}}n_{j}^{\mathrm{out}} . It measures execution output, whereas stored and processed supervised tokens measure the subsequent training data and optimization exposure. Across the eligible pools, the 210 multi-agent episodes average 141,844 generated tokens and the 103 single-agent episodes average 59,355. The ratio of these means is 2.39, or approximately 2.4 times as many generated tokens for multi-agent execution. This calculation uses the full eligible pools; the pairwise comparisons below use a subset of the multi-agent episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的轨迹长度统计了每个回合中所有 API 请求的完成令牌数，包括协调器和所有执行器：N_{\mathrm{gen}}(e)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal{J}_{e}}n_{j}^{\mathrm{out}}。 它衡量的是执行输出，而存储和处理的监督令牌则衡量后续的训练数据和优化暴露量。 在所有符合条件的池中，210 个多智能体回合平均生成 141,844 个令牌，而 103 个单智能体回合平均生成 59,355 个令牌。 这两个均值的比值为 2.39，即多智能体执行的生成令牌数约为单智能体的 2.4 倍。 此计算使用了全部符合条件的池；下方的成对比较则使用了多智能体回合的一个子集。

There are 206 pairs involving 101 distinct multi-agent episodes. Opponents may be reused. Each pair receives four external judgments: GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8, each with seeds 42 and 43. paragraphs.en: The pooled win rate is 85.1 % 85.1\% ; giving all eight task rates equal weight gives 79.3 % 79.3\% . The comparable-length result uses only ten pairs, involving ten single-agent and eight multi-agent episodes. Even the same-workflow comparison retains the directive difference. These results show an output-quality advantage in the saved comparisons, but do not isolate the effect of delegation: workflow mixtures, verification instructions, and successful-completion selection also differ. Matching realized lengths does not impose an equal generation budget, and workspace preference does not assess every SFT target.
paragraphs.zh: 合并后的胜率为 85.1% 85.1\%；若给予全部八个任务率相等的权重，则胜率为 79.3% 79.3\%。 长度可比较的结果仅使用了十对数据，其中包括十个单智能体回合和八个多智能体回合。 即使是相同工作流的比较，也保留了指令上的差异。 这些结果表明，在已保存的比较中，输出质量具有优势，但并未单独区分委托效应：工作流混合、验证指令以及成功完成的选择也存在差异。 匹配实际长度并不意味着生成预算相等，且工作区偏好也无法评估所有 SFT 目标。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate trajectories in Section 5.1 combine changes to workflow text with variation in the agent’s execution. A concrete example occurs on task 53 in the all-Qwen base lineage. paragraphs.en: We embed components and task descriptions with both text-embedding-3-large ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and all-mpnet-base-v2 ( Song et al., 2020 ) . Long text is split into chunks whose normalized embeddings are averaged. The hop sequence is resampled at eight phase anchors. paragraphs.en: Unadjusted estimates use all eligible agents at each iteration. For permutation adjustment, each of 400 repetitions samples 43 agents without replacement and subtracts one shuffled estimate from the observed estimate. Task information shuffles task-description embeddings across agents. Total correlation independently shuffles the rows of each component block. Task-centered total correlation first subtracts task means within the sampled set, then shuffles the centered blocks. The reported value is the mean of these differences. It measures excess over the shuffled baseline and does not guarantee an unbiased information estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 未经调整的估计值在每次迭代中都使用所有符合条件的智能体。 对于排列调整，400次重复中的每一次都会无放回地抽取43个智能体，并从观测到的估计值中减去一个经过重排的估计值。 任务信息会将任务描述嵌入在不同智能体之间进行重排。 总相关性会独立地重排每个组件块的行。 以任务为中心的总相关性首先会在采样集合内减去任务均值，然后对中心化后的块进行重排。 报告的值是这些差异的平均值。 它衡量的是相对于重排基线的超出部分，并不保证信息估计是无偏的。

sents.en: The detailed trace and SFT audit below concerns the first-cycle student M + = ℒ ( 1 ) M^{+}={\mathcal{L}}^{(1)} : its 110 bare-prompt rollouts, the 110 fixed base references, and 114 of the 119 selected teachers.
sents.zh: 下方的详细追踪和 SFT 审计涉及第一周期的学生 M + = ℒ ( 1 ) M^{+}={\mathcal{L}}^{(1)}：其 110 次裸提示运行、110 个固定基线参考，以及从 119 个选中教师中选取的 114 个。

sents.en: Five historical teacher episodes, containing 100 training windows, are outside the audit’s coverage.
sents.zh: 五个历史教师片段（包含 100 个训练窗口）不在本次审计的覆盖范围内。

sents.en: All measurements use saved traces; no additional rollouts are required.
sents.zh: 所有测量均使用已保存的追踪数据；无需进行任何额外的运行。

paragraphs.en: The 220 student/base prompt files match the bare task prompts after trimming whitespace. Their initial main-thread API requests contain no teacher directive, report empty episode memory, and use identical agent-tool definitions. We measure four events from successful, explicit tool operations:
paragraphs.zh: 经过空白符修剪后，这 220 个学生/基础提示文件与原始任务提示完全匹配。 它们最初的主线程 API 请求不包含任何教师指令，报告为空的事件记忆，并使用完全相同的智能体工具定义。 我们从成功且明确使用的工具操作中测量四个事件：

sents.en: The 220 student/base prompt files match the bare task prompts after trimming whitespace.
sents.zh: 经过空白符修剪后，这 220 个学生/基础提示文件与原始任务提示完全匹配。

sents.en: Their initial main-thread API requests contain no teacher directive, report empty episode memory, and use identical agent-tool definitions.
sents.zh: 它们最初的主线程 API 请求不包含任何教师指令，报告为空的事件记忆，并使用完全相同的智能体工具定义。

sents.en: We measure four events from successful, explicit tool operations:
sents.zh: 我们从成功且明确使用的工具操作中测量四个事件：

paragraphs.en: Delegation ( D D ): a worker call returns without a tool error.
paragraphs.zh: 委派 ( D D )：工作者调用返回时没有工具错误。

paragraphs.en: Code handoff ( H H ): a worker writes a Python file and returns, then a different worker reads that file. The producer must be its latest recorded writer.
paragraphs.zh: 代码交接（H H）：一名工作者编写一个 Python 文件并返回，然后由另一名工作者读取该文件。 生产者必须是其最新记录到的编写者。

sents.en: Code handoff ( H H ): a worker writes a Python file and returns, then a different worker reads that file.
sents.zh: 代码交接（H H）：一名工作者编写一个 Python 文件并返回，然后由另一名工作者读取该文件。

sents.en: The producer must be its latest recorded writer.
sents.zh: 生产者必须是其最新记录到的编写者。

paragraphs.en: Subagent revision: a later worker writes or edits Python code produced by a different, already completed worker.
paragraphs.zh: 子智能体修订：后续的智能体编写或修改由另一个已完成智能体生成的 Python 代码。

paragraphs.en: Main edit: the orchestrator edits worker-originated Python code after the worker returns.
paragraphs.zh: 主要编辑：在工作者返回后，协调器会编辑由工作者生成的 Python 代码。

paragraphs.en: File operations use explicit write_file , edit , and read calls. Reads through imports or shell commands and writes inside shell scripts are not counted. Nested actions are assigned to their top-level worker. These definitions record execution structure: a returned worker can report failure, a read need not use the interface correctly, and an edit need not fix a problem. Five of M + M^{+} ’s 281 worker returns contain no model-visible report.
paragraphs.zh: 文件操作使用显式的 write_file、edit 和 read 调用。 通过导入或 shell 命令进行的读取以及在 shell 脚本内部的写入不计入统计。 嵌套动作被分配给其顶层的智能体。 这些定义记录了执行结构：返回的智能体可能报告失败，读取操作未必正确使用接口，编辑操作也未必能解决问题。 M + M^{+} 的 281 个智能体返回结果中，有五个不包含模型可见的报告。

sents.en: File operations use explicit write_file , edit , and read calls.
sents.zh: 文件操作使用显式的 write_file、edit 和 read 调用。

sents.en: Reads through imports or shell commands and writes inside shell scripts are not counted.
sents.zh: 通过导入或 shell 命令进行的读取以及在 shell 脚本内部的写入不计入统计。

sents.en: Nested actions are assigned to their top-level worker.
sents.zh: 嵌套动作被分配给其顶层的智能体。

sents.en: These definitions record execution structure: a returned worker can report failure, a read need not use the interface correctly, and an edit need not fix a problem.
sents.zh: 这些定义记录了执行结构：返回的智能体可能报告失败，读取操作未必正确使用接口，编辑操作也未必能解决问题。

sents.en: Five of M + M^{+} ’s 281 worker returns contain no model-visible report.
sents.zh: M + M^{+} 的 281 个智能体返回结果中，有五个不包含模型可见的报告。

paragraphs.en: The base already performs the coordination patterns observed after SFT. Table 14 applies the same audit to the generic-directive control in Appendix C.4 . With this prompt, both models delegate in every episode; the base performs code handoffs in 103 of 110 episodes. Under a bare prompt, the base’s task 202 episode (seed 2154005) forms a six-worker pipeline and repairs an mmCIF-column mismatch after execution fails. This shows that both coordination and execution-conditioned repair are available before post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型已经执行了 SFT 后观察到的协调模式。 表 14 对附录 C.4 中的通用指令控制应用了相同的审计。 在此提示下，两个模型在每个回合中都会进行委托；基础模型在 110 个回合中有 103 个回合执行了代码移交。 在没有额外提示的情况下，基础模型在第 202 个回合（种子 2154005）中构建了一个由六个智能体组成的流水线，并在执行失败后修复了 mmCIF 列的不匹配问题。 这表明协调和执行条件修复在训练后阶段之前就已经具备。

sents.en: The base already performs the coordination patterns observed after SFT.
sents.zh: 基础模型已经执行了 SFT 后观察到的协调模式。

sents.en: Table 14 applies the same audit to the generic-directive control in Appendix C.4 .
sents.zh: 表 14 对附录 C.4 中的通用指令控制应用了相同的审计。

sents.zh: 在此提示下，两个模型在每个回合中都会进行委托；基础模型在 110 个回合中有 103 个回合执行了代码移交。

sents.en: Under a bare prompt, the base’s task 202 episode (seed 2154005) forms a six-worker pipeline and repairs an mmCIF-column mismatch after execution fails.
sents.zh: 在没有额外提示的情况下，基础模型在第 202 个回合（种子 2154005）中构建了一个由六个智能体组成的流水线，并在执行失败后修复了 mmCIF 列的不匹配问题。

paragraphs.en: We decode the frozen training windows with the training tokenizer and match complete tool-call arguments to the source streams. Worker assignments identify the source thread. A retained target requires the entire tool call to carry loss. A sampled target additionally requires its window to appear in the deduplicated exposure log through the selected checkpoint, step 1200.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用训练分词器对冻结的训练窗口进行解码，并将完整的工具调用参数与源流进行匹配。 工作分配会确定源线程。 保留的目标要求整个工具调用必须承担损失。 采样的目标还要求其窗口必须通过选定的检查点（步骤 1200）出现在去重后的曝光日志中。

sents.en: We decode the frozen training windows with the training tokenizer and match complete tool-call arguments to the source streams.
sents.zh: 我们使用训练分词器对冻结的训练窗口进行解码，并将完整的工具调用参数与源流进行匹配。

sents.en: Worker assignments identify the source thread.
sents.zh: 工作分配会确定源线程。

sents.en: A retained target requires the entire tool call to carry loss.
sents.zh: 保留的目标要求整个工具调用必须承担损失。

sents.en: A sampled target additionally requires its window to appear in the deduplicated exposure log through the selected checkpoint, step 1200.
sents.zh: 采样的目标还要求其窗口必须通过选定的检查点（步骤 1200）出现在去重后的曝光日志中。

paragraphs.en: The audit covers 2,335 windows from 114 teachers. All 114 contain retained orchestrator assignments, 98 contain retained code handoffs, and 57 contain retained worker revisions. The sampled counts in Table 2(b) are 112, 79, and 37 episodes. For a handoff, both the producer’s write and consumer’s read must be sampled; for a revision, both the earlier write and later modification must be sampled. They can occur in different windows and steps. A sampled episode therefore witnesses the relevant actions, not necessarily its entire trajectory. All 698 audited orchestrator assignments are retained targets, of which 673 are sampled at least once. Conservative matching and incomplete trace coverage make these counts lower bounds on observed exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计涵盖了来自 114 名教师的 2,335 个窗口。 全部 114 个窗口均包含保留的协调器分配，98 个包含保留的代码交接，57 个包含保留的工作者修订。 表 2(b) 中的抽样计数为 112、79 和 37 个事件序列。 对于一次交接，必须同时抽样生产方的写入和消费方的读取；对于一次修订，则必须同时抽样先前的写入和后续的修改。 它们可能发生在不同的窗口和步骤中。 因此，一个被抽样的事件序列仅能观察到相关操作，而非其完整的轨迹。 所有 698 个经过审计的协调器分配均为保留目标，其中 673 个至少被抽样过一次。 保守的匹配方式和不完整的追踪覆盖使得这些计数成为实际观察暴露量的下限。

sents.zh: 此次审计涵盖了来自 114 名教师的 2,335 个窗口。

sents.zh: 它们可能发生在不同的窗口和步骤中。

paragraphs.en: In task 51 (teacher seed 990010), an auditor finds that shock features use post-event returns overlapping the prediction targets. The orchestrator recalls the feature worker to remove those returns and widen the embargo. The worker reads and edits the code, regenerates features, and runs checks. The auditor’s report is masked context for the supervised recall, in a window sampled four times before step 1200. A worker window containing the implementation and checks is sampled once. Both the decision and its execution receive supervision. The first diagnostic incorrectly treats NaN correlations as passing, so this example also shows that a supervised revision can contain faulty verification.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务 51（教师种子 990010）中，一名审计员发现冲击特征使用了与预测目标重叠的事件后收益率。 协调员召回了特征处理程序，以移除这些收益率并扩大禁制范围。 该处理程序读取并编辑代码、重新生成特征，然后运行检查。 审计员的报告是监督性召回的掩码上下文，其窗口在步骤 1200 之前被采样了四次。 一个包含实现代码和检查项的处理程序窗口被采样了一次。 决策及其执行都接受了监督。 第一个诊断错误地将 NaN 相关性视为通过，因此该示例也表明，监督性修订可能包含有缺陷的验证。

paragraphs.en: These observations support increased bare-prompt use of coordination already available in the base. They do not identify which training example caused a student action or isolate optimized workflow text from the directive, data selection, and sampler. More revisions also do not by themselves establish more successful repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果支持在基础模型中已有的协调机制上，更多地使用裸提示。 它们并未确定是哪个训练样本引发了学生的行为，也未将优化后的工作流程文本与指令、数据选择和采样器区分开来。 更多的修订本身也无法证明修复更为成功。

sents.zh: 这些观察结果支持在基础模型中已有的协调机制上，更多地使用裸提示。

sents.zh: 更多的修订本身也无法证明修复更为成功。

paragraphs.en: In task 305 (seed 2310005), the student launches workers for environment construction, demonstrations, symbolic planning, policy training, evaluation, and evaluation revision. The demonstration worker reads the environment’s task_generator.py ; later workers read the demonstration, planner, and policy modules. Recorded commands train the policy and run the assembled benchmark (Figure 9 ). The episode wins all six comparisons with its base reference. The trace establishes artifact-dependent implementation, without certifying every simulation choice or reported metric.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务 305（种子 2310005）中，学生为环境构建、演示、符号规划、策略训练、评估和评估修订启动了智能体。 演示智能体读取了环境的 task_generator.py；后续的智能体则读取了演示、规划器和策略模块。 记录下来的命令用于训练策略并运行已组装的基准测试（图 9）。 该回合与其基础参考在所有六次比较中均获胜。 该轨迹确立了依赖人工制品的实现方式，但并未对每一次模拟选择或所报告的指标进行认证。

sents.zh: 在任务 305（种子 2310005）中，学生为环境构建、演示、符号规划、策略训练、评估和评估修订启动了智能体。

sents.en: Recorded commands train the policy and run the assembled benchmark (Figure 9 ).
sents.zh: 记录下来的命令用于训练策略并运行已组装的基准测试（图 9）。

sents.en: The episode wins all six comparisons with its base reference.
sents.zh: 该回合与其基础参考在所有六次比较中均获胜。

sents.en: The trace establishes artifact-dependent implementation, without certifying every simulation choice or reported metric.

paragraphs.en: In task 302 (seed 2306010), evaluation finds that a learned A* heuristic expands 2,934.9 nodes on average versus 571.4 for Manhattan distance. The student passes this diagnostic to a training worker, repairs a normalization-interface mismatch, reruns evaluation, and requests an independent critic. The final report retains the unfavorable result: about 5.1 times as many expanded nodes. This case shows revision and checking without requiring a favorable scientific conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务 302（种子 2306010）中，评估发现，一个经过学习的 A* 启发式方法平均扩展了 2,934.9 个节点，而曼哈顿距离仅扩展了 571.4 个节点。 学生将此诊断结果传递给训练工作者，修复了归一化接口不匹配的问题，重新运行评估，并请求一名独立评论员。 最终报告保留了不利结果：扩展的节点数量约为原来的 5.1 倍。 这个案例表明，无需得出有利的科学结论，也可以进行修订和检查。

paragraphs.en: In task 305 (seed 2310008), failed push and lever evaluations lead the student to request a simulator revision. The revision replaces force-driven motion with direct repositioning toward the goal and removes simulation steps. The worker then reports success on all three task types. This episode receives five favorable judgments out of six, despite changing the physical meaning of success. Coordination and high workspace preference therefore do not guarantee that a revision preserves the scientific task.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务 305（种子 2310008）中，失败的推送和杠杆评估促使学生要求对模拟器进行修订。 此次修订将基于力的驱动运动替换为直接朝向目标重新定位，并移除了模拟步骤。 随后，该智能体报告在所有三种任务类型上均取得成功。 尽管成功的具体物理含义发生了变化，这一过程仍获得了六次评估中的五次正面评价。 因此，协调性和对高工作空间的选择并不保证修订后的方案能够保留任务的科学属性。

sents.zh: 在任务 305（种子 2310008）中，失败的推送和杠杆评估促使学生要求对模拟器进行修订。

sents.en: The revision replaces force-driven motion with direct repositioning toward the goal and removes simulation steps.

sents.en: Coordination and high workspace preference therefore do not guarantee that a revision preserves the scientific task.
sents.zh: 因此，协调性和对高工作空间的选择并不保证修订后的方案能够保留任务的科学属性。

paragraphs.en: The following saved bare prompts give one training task per domain: finance (51), pharmacy (202), and robotics (307).
